citation.title: KSTAR Status and Upgrade Plan Toward Fusion Reactor
citation.authors: Jong-Gu Kwak; T. Rhee; H. Han; J. S. Kang; J. G. Bak; H. J. Ahn; Y. U. Nam; H. S. Kim; M. Kim; W. H. Ko; S. W. Yoon; W. C. Kim; K. R. Park

topic: KSTAR machine status, long-pulse and high-beta_p scenarios, RMP ELM control, PCS upgrade, diagnostics and heating upgrade overview through the 2018 campaign
own_question: Summarize KSTAR progress and plan upgrades toward steady-state, reactor-relevant operation.
actual_method_and_evidence: Review of campaign results to 2018: about 90 s discharge #21735, ECH-position effects on TAEs, ITB and RMP experiments, PCS/rtEFIT upgrade. Diagnostics section lists BES, ECEI, CES, Thomson scattering and MSE qualitatively. It gives no CES timing, latency, cadence or nowcasting analysis and no 2022 data.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR has BES and ECE imaging fluctuation diagnostics. NBI supplies the beam used by charge exchange spectroscopy and MSE profile diagnostics.
claim_checks.qualification: This is a qualitative facility description only. It gives no rates, latencies or details on carbon-impurity versus main-ion CES.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: None reported. The paper does not state CES report arrival or integration times.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer CES latency, cadence or a need for nowcasting.
Do not treat the planned real-time functions or real-time MSE as achieved profile control.
Do not apply 2018-campaign facts to the KSTAR2022 data.
Do not cite this paper as support for BES/ECEI predicting ion temperature.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Optional single facility-context citation for KSTAR's diagnostic suite and real-time control infrastructure. It carries no evidence on our timing or estimation question.
